name: v48_model_revision_without_reversal_risk
hypothesis: The negative analyst-revision derivative has signal, but prior versions became crowded through close/open, graph, news, or payout stabilizers; a risk-only stabilizer may test the model signal more cleanly.
expression: 0.55 * rank(-1 * analyst_revision_rank_derivative) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: No close/open, option, graph, news, EPS, or accounting-quality anchor; strict corr gate vs MPpGzqwr/O0pNbJ17.

name: v48_model_revision_social_calm
hypothesis: A negative model revision signal may be less crowded when filtered by stable social sentiment rather than price reversal or option flow.
expression: 0.45 * rank(-1 * analyst_revision_rank_derivative) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(scl12_sentiment_fast_d1, 20), 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_60_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Uses social only as a calmness filter; social-alone was weak, so require the model signal to carry performance.

name: v48_ppne_asset_age_efficiency
hypothesis: Lower accumulated depreciation relative to gross PP&E plus lower machinery intensity may identify cleaner, newer productive assets without using ROE, cashflow, tax, lease, or goodwill parents.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * accumulated_depreciation_depletion_amortization_ppne / ppe_gross_value, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * gross_machinery_equipment_value_2 / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Revisits PPE/asset-age without customer authority or operating-quality anchors; field gross_machinery_equipment_value_2 has high coverage and alphaCount 0.

name: v48_debt_maturity_ladder_relief
hypothesis: Companies with lower near/intermediate debt repayment pressure and lower stated debt rates should have cleaner refinancing risk than peers.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_repayments_total_2 / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_repayment_year_three / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_instrument_interest_rate_percent, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Different from v34 debt-rate candidate by adding maturity ladder and removing cash-interest/current-tax style anchors; likely high accounting corr, so gate strictly.

name: v48_debt_issuance_avoidance
hypothesis: Low debt issuance proceeds relative to assets and low interest expense may identify firms not dependent on fresh debt financing.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_issuance_proceeds_2 / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * interest_expense / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Debt-financing pressure path without buyback, cashflow_op, credit-facility capacity, or close/open.

name: v48_social_negative_buzz_relief_slow
hypothesis: A slower decline in negative social buzz and calmer fast sentiment may produce a lower-turnover social signal than previous fast-d1 attempts.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_bfl_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_90_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 126), industry)
notes: Tests whether very slow social relief can overcome v41/v28 high-turnover weakness; no news/event or reversal parent.

name: v48_pcr_volume_curve_risk_only
hypothesis: Put/call volume term-structure may contain positioning information independent of breakeven/skew if combined only with risk-state relief.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(pcr_vol_10 - pcr_vol_180, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(pcr_vol_60 - pcr_vol_180), 90), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: No call/put breakeven, no IV skew, no close/open; prior raw PCR was weak, but this tests a slow risk-conditioned curve.

name: v48_current_tax_mix_independent
hypothesis: The mix of current federal and state/local tax expenses can proxy cleaner taxable income realization without using deferred-tax allowance or cashflow_op.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(current_federal_tax_expense_amount / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(current_state_local_tax_expense_amount / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(deferred_local_income_tax_expense) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 126), industry)
notes: Distinct from deferred-tax valuation allowance/prepaid tax ACTIVE, but likely accounting-corr; submit only if corr is clearly below gate.

name: v48_capital_lease_structure
hypothesis: Low capital lease obligations and near-term lease payments may capture fixed-cost flexibility separately from operating lease burden.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * capital_lease_liability_balance / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * current_minimum_capital_lease_payment / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * future_minimum_capital_lease_payments / assets, 126), industry)
notes: Tests capital lease rather than operating lease; sparse coverage may create concentration/sub-universe failures.

name: v48_analyst_range_market_neutral_no_sales
hypothesis: Adjusted-income range tightening failed as an industry-neutral direct signal, but MARKET neutralization and higher decay may reduce sub-universe/turnover issues without reusing sales dispersion.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(max_adj_net_income_quarterly_estimate - min_adj_net_income_quarterly_estimate) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(num_adj_net_income_est, 63), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: One controlled rescue of v32 adjusted-income range; no sales-count term and no EPS level.
